description: This file defines the OA_DB_Upgrade class, which manages database schema upgrades, including schema parsing, change application, backups, rollbacks, and related scripting within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_DB_Upgrade
classes.description: A utility class for managing database schema upgrades, including parsing schema files, applying changes, backups, rollbacks, and executing pre/post scripts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: PHP4 constructor initializing paths, logger, schema, and cache.

methods.name: initMDB2Schema
methods.description: Instantiates the MDB2 schema object and sets up SQL statements.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the upgrade process, loads schema and changeset definitions, and prepares migration classes.

methods.name: buildSchemaDefinition
methods.description: Loads and parses the schema definition XML file into internal structures.

methods.name: buildChangesetDefinition
methods.description: Loads and parses the changeset definition, using cache if available.

methods.name: applySchemaDefinitionChanges
methods.description: Applies specific adjustments to schema definitions based on version.

methods.name: _prepScript
methods.description: Prepares and instantiates pre/post scripts from external files.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the database schema upgrade to a specified version, including verification, backup, and task execution.

methods.name: checkSchemaIntegrity
methods.description: Checks database schema integrity against the definition files.

methods.name: _backup
methods.description: Creates backups of affected tables before upgrade.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Reverts database to previous state using backups and drop new tables.

methods.name: prepRollbackByAuditId
methods.description: Prepares rollback data based on audit ID, retrieving backup and new table info.
